verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline at a sensible size and spreads the content down the column, but the gaps between blocks are uneven and too large. Alignment is mixed: the dates sit off-centre and 'WORSHIP & BIBLE STUDY' is left-aligned while everything else is centred, and the hiker/mountain illustration has shrunk to a small strip at the bottom. B's headline is oversized and breaks awkwardly ('ST.' sits alone on its own line). It jams all the copy into the top half, with the dates and the worship line pushed left, then leaves a large dead gap above a tiny illustration, so B has the worse balance.
